public enum IAPProductType
{
    None,
    RemoveAds,
    Bundle,
    Coin500,
    Coin1000,
    Coin2500,
    Coin5000,
}

public enum IAPButtonType
{
    None,
    Purchase,
    Restore
}

public static class IAPProductIDs
{
    public const string RemoveAds = "com.zg.smash.game.remove.ads";
    public const string Bundle = "com.zg.smash.game.bundle";
    public const string Coin500 = "com.zg.smash.game.coin500";
    public const string Coin1000 = "com.zg.smash.game.coin1000";
    public const string Coin2500 = "com.zg.smash.game.coin2500";
    public const string Coin5000 = "com.zg.smash.game.coin5000";

    public static string GetProductId(IAPProductType productType)
    {
        switch (productType)
        {
            case IAPProductType.RemoveAds:
                return RemoveAds;

            case IAPProductType.Bundle:
                return Bundle;

            case IAPProductType.Coin500:
                return Coin500;

            case IAPProductType.Coin1000:
                return Coin1000;

            case IAPProductType.Coin2500:
                return Coin2500;

            case IAPProductType.Coin5000:
                return Coin5000;

            default:
                return null;
        }
    }
}
